description: Create complete Supabase SQL schema file that drops all old tables and creates new ones with RLS policies, indexes, and storage buckets. Then remove all Kotlin/Gradle project files and set up Flutter project scaffolding (pubspec.yaml, analysis_options.yaml, directory structure, CI workflow).
steps: Create supabase/schema_v2.sql with: (a) DROP TABLE statements for all 16 existing tables (users, creator_profiles, brand_profiles, wallets, transactions, deposits, withdrawals, campaigns, campaign_applications, deliverables, notifications, products, orders, subscriptions, kyc_documents, audit_logs), (b) CREATE TABLE statements for all new tables per the user's blueprint (users, wallets, creator_profiles, brand_profiles, campaigns, applications, submissions, deposits, withdrawals, products, orders, order_items, notifications, audit_logs, messages, kyc_documents, platform_settings), (c) RLS policies enabling authenticated access per role, (d) proper indexes on foreign keys and frequently queried columns, (e) storage bucket creation for avatars, kyc-documents, campaign-assets, product-images, deposit-proofs

Delete all Kotlin/Gradle files: rm -rf app/ gradle/ build.gradle.kts settings.gradle.kts gradle.properties gradlew gradlew.bat create_wrapper.sh scripts/ and all markdown docs (ARCHITECTURE.md, BUILD_INSTRUCTIONS.md, BUILD_STATUS.md, CI_CD_COMPLETE.md, FEATURES.md, FINAL_FIX_SUMMARY.md, GITHUB_SECRETS.md, IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE.md, PERMANENT_FIX_EXPLAINED.md, PHASE_1_2_COMPLETE.md, PHASE_3_5_COMPLETE.md, WORKFLOW_SIMPLIFIED.md)
Delete old supabase/schema.sql and supabase/functions/ and supabase/migrations/, keep supabase/ dir with only the new schema_v2.sql (rename to schema.sql)

Create pubspec.yaml with dependencies: flutter, supabase_flutter, go_router, flutter_riverpod, riverpod_annotation, google_fonts, cached_network_image, shimmer, flutter_animate, iconsax_flutter, intl, image_picker, url_launcher, flutter_svg, shared_preferences. Dev deps: flutter_test, flutter_lints, riverpod_generator, build_runner, custom_lint_rules

Create lib/ directory structure: lib/main.dart, lib/app.dart, lib/core/ (theme/, constants/, utils/, widgets/), lib/features/ (auth/, home/, campaigns/, shop/, profile/), lib/services/ (supabase_service.dart, storage_service.dart)

Create .github/workflows/flutter-build.yml replacing android-build.yml: checkout, setup Flutter, flutter pub get, flutter analyze, flutter build apk, upload artifact. Use secrets.SUPABASE_URL and secrets.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
Create a new README.md for the Flutter project
acceptance_criteria: supabase/schema.sql contains DROP TABLE IF EXISTS CASCADE for all old tables
supabase/schema.sql contains CREATE TABLE for all 17 new tables with proper types, constraints, and foreign keys
supabase/schema.sql contains ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY for every table
supabase/schema.sql contains CREATE POLICY statements for each table
supabase/schema.sql contains CREATE INDEX statements for performance-critical columns
supabase/schema.sql contains INSERT INTO storage.buckets for required buckets
All Kotlin/Gradle files are deleted from the repository
pubspec.yaml is valid YAML with all required dependencies
.github/workflows/flutter-build.yml is a valid GitHub Actions workflow for Flutter
lib/ directory structure exists with placeholder files
verification: Verify supabase/schema.sql has DROP, CREATE TABLE, RLS, POLICY, and INDEX statements
Verify pubspec.yaml parses as valid YAML
